name: Inspiration Of The Holy Spirit The
overview: The Scriptures reveal that the inspiration of the Holy Spirit is a powerful and sovereign work by which God enables individuals to prophesy and speak His word. In Numbers 11, the Spirit rested upon the seventy elders, including Eldad and Medad, causing them to prophesy even outside the tabernacle, demonstrating that the Spirit’s influence is not limited by human boundaries. Similarly, in 2 Chronicles 20, the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jahaziel, empowering him to deliver God’s message of assurance and direction to the people of Judah, underscoring the Spirit’s role in guiding and strengthening God’s servants in times of need.
